pkgmetadata.longdescription:
A comprehensive localized keyboard configuration matrix and terminal binding ecosystem optimized for inputting Algic and Algonquian language orthographies. This engine provides native mapping translation rules for modern dialects, historical linguistic reconstructions, and geographical variants. It includes specific layout components for:
- Miami-Illinois (Myaamia) and Potawatomi (supporting macrons and post-Z acute vowel structures like é) - Sauk/Fox, Kickapoo, and Shawnee (supporting specialized theta and glottal markers) - Proto-Algonquian historical reconstructions (providing the voiceless lateral fricative ɬ) - California isolates including Yurok and Wiyot (mapping soft gamma ɣ and barred-l ł sequences)

use.flag: Deploys native keystroke chord and Alt-modifier macro profiles natively into global /etc/skel/.inputrc file mappings for command line interfaces
